Clifftop Cabins
0
NESTLED ON THE CLIFF’S EDGE IN KAIKOURA,
UNMATCHED OCEAN PANORAMIC VIEWS ABOUND.
LUXURY CABINS ON THE PENINSULA
A unique accommodation experience, our three cabins are nestled on the cliff’s edge with unparalleled panoramic views over the Ocean. Beautifully designed and built, our cabins offer all the comforts of home in a truly breathtaking location.
Enjoy magical sunsets from the outdoor bath, relax on the lawn or spot a passing whale or pod of dolphins as you sip on a glass high on the Kaikoura Peninsula.
With a view like this, you’d expect to be miles from anywhere. Instead we’re just a short stroll to the beach for safe swimming or a leisurely walk into Kaikoura town.
Learn More
Take a Tour
Staying in our cabins for a night or more, you’ll know you’ll have all the amenities at hand to have a relaxing and rejuvenating stay. Take a look around and fall in love with our place.
View Gallery
PEACE & TRANQUILITY
Set on the property of Dover Cottage, the cabins are just far enough from town that you will escape the usual noises. Instead you’ll be drawn to the sounds of nature - birdsong, the wind whistling across the ocean and the crashing of waves on the rocks below.
Our family live close by in Dover’s Cottage but your privacy is important to us, so we’ll be on hand only as you require - just a phone call away if needed.
Learn More
“ Kaikoura is full of so many magical spots and we've got ONE OF the best oneS. We look forward to having you stay. ”
- Seth & Penny, Clifftop Cabins

About Clifftop Cabins
0
CREATING A HOME AWAY FROM HOME.
Seth and Penny, the proprietors of Clifftop Cabins, made Kaikoura their home for their family in 2018. They live with their three children, Jack (10), Otis (7) and Albie (3).The Dover Cottage property where the cabins are located has been in Penny’s family for three generations.
For the first year or two they were in Kaikoura, Penny hosted guests on their property who were after a glamping experience, but then came the time to upgrade the accommodation and provide a more permanent place for guests to stay.
As a builder, Seth was able to design and build the three cabins, understanding exactly how the cabins should look to complement the Kaikoura landscape. Penny then offering her eye for detail was able to turn the buildings into comfortable dwellings to welcome guests.
The couple who love to host and entertain, understand that it’s the small touches that sometimes matter the most and have set about to create three spaces that are filled with everything you need to create a home away from home.
THE CABINS
Located on the picturesque Kaikoura Peninsula, just walking distance to the beach, local Cafes & restaurants, you’ll find the three Clifftop Cabins. Nestled on the cliff with unmatched panoramic views, Clifftop Cabins provide you with a unique accommodation experience. Our beautifully built and designed modern cabins offer all the comforts of home, in a truly unique and breath-taking location.
Enjoy magical sunsets from the outdoor bath or relax on the lawn and try to spot a passing whale or pod of dolphins. While the cabins undoubtedly boast one of the best views Kaikoura has to offer, you’ll be surprised to know we’re close to town and the restaurants & cafes are only a two minute drive, or 30 minute walk away. Add in a private stargazing experience right here on site.
If you’re keen to soak up the sea, we’re just a a short stroll down Dempseys track to the beach front where you can enjoy safe swimming or sunbathing.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED & MORE
We get that sleeping in a bed that’s not yours can sometimes be challenging. That’s why we’ve invested in a comfortable King-sized bed in each room. Like any decent accommodation, we’ve got a range of toiletries available to use, as well as all the other facilities you’ll need for your stay.
King Bed with under-bed storage
Outdoor Kitchen with induction cook top and everything you need to cook on site
Indoor Kitchennette with Microwave, Fridge, Kettle, Nescafe Coffee Machine, Tea, coffee etc
Heatpump for warming & cooling
Outdoor Stone Bath
Smart TV
Free Wifi
Hair Dryer
FEATURES
Book Now
BEFORE YOU BOOK
Cancellations received seven days before arrival are free of charge. However, cancellations within seven days are not refundable and will be charged to your nominated credit card.
Cancellations
As much as we love kids, we don’t allow children under 10 to stay in our cabins. Given our location near a cliff, we don’t think it’s ideal to have little ones here. It also helps to keep the property a sanctuary for those spending their time purposefully away from little ones.
CHILDREN
Check in is between 2 – 7pm and checkout is requested by 11am. If you require checkin outside those times, please get in touch .
ARRIVALS & CHECKOUTS
Our prices are in NZ dollars. Rates are based on 1 or 2 people using the room unless otherwise arranged.
RATES
We allocate one parking spot for every cabin. Please let us know when booking if you will be bringing an additional car.
Parking
SMOKING
Smoking or vaping is not allowed anywhere on the property.
While we clear & clean the rooms thoroughly between stays, we are not liable for loss of guest’s property.
LIABILITY

PETS
Unfortunately our property and cabins are not suitable for any pets.
